prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity native Windows Flutter app composition, option B for Wabbit TV My Library
Primary request: Design the complete first viewport of the Wabbit TV "My Library" destination at exactly a 1265 by 713 landscape window. This is an Operate surface, not marketing.
Input images: use the three referenced approved Wabbit TV comps only for the fixed Quiet Broadcast visual system: native black title bar, collapsed 72px rail, graphite planes, Segoe UI-like type, compact 6-8px geometry, warm white, quiet gray, and one amber focus signal.
Structure: title bar; collapsed rail with seven destination icons and My Library selected; content header "My Library" with subtitle "Your saved library"; a 250px left Library directory and a dominant right mixed ledger.
Option B topology: the left directory is extra dense and scan-first. It lists "Favorites" selected, then a quiet "Custom groups" label followed by "Living Room", "Weekend Movies", "News & Sports", and "Kids", each with an aligned item count. The right begins with "Favorites" and a single low summary strip showing "12 items", "4 Live", "5 Movies", and "3 Series" separated by thin lines. Below is a dense mixed ledger of seven 58px rows with 50x36 artwork, synthetic title, LIVE/MOVIE/SERIES label, and quiet source. Focus is on the selected "Favorites" directory row with a crisp 2px amber edge; the ledger remains visible and stable. No create/edit/add/remove actions.
Style/medium: flat matte native product UI screenshot. Near-black graphite #111212, raised #222321, signal amber #FFB347, 1px separators, crisp almost-square controls, no decorative effects.
Composition/framing: straight-on full-window screenshot, exact landscape viewport, television-readable but dense.
Constraints: synthetic artwork and titles only. Preserve directory-not-storefront. No poster grid, hero, recommendations, promotional copy, gradients, glass, neon glow, large shadows, floating cards, rabbit illustration, provider logos, credentials, URLs, chips, pills, or mobile layout.
